releaseNotes:
SAM 0.12.23 hardens the software-update pipeline, makes the Agent's monitoring loop more resilient to transient failures, and gives the installer a cleaner, single-screen setup experience.

- Fixed a validation gap in the software-update pipeline that could let a crafted package id run unintended commands on an enrolled device; update jobs are now checked against the real shape of a winget package id before they're ever accepted.
- The Agent's offline event queue now recovers on its own from a single corrupted line instead of getting stuck retrying the same bad entry indefinitely.
- A failing heartbeat or policy check no longer holds up local process detection and blocked-app enforcement for that cycle.
- Fixed a rare timing issue in the background inventory-scan scheduler.
- The Agent now recovers gracefully if its local state file is ever corrupted, instead of stopping.
- Redesigned the installer as a single screen: enter your Company Enrollment Token, accept the terms, and it installs unattended, opening Synergysoft SAM when it's done.
